adjust_brightness_image: adjust the brightness of a JAX image array by adding a delta value to each channel
adjust_contrast_image: adjust the contrast of a JAX image array by a multiplicative factor around the spatial mean
adjust_gamma_image: adjust the gamma of a JAX image array using an exponent and optional gain multiplier
elastic_deformation_image: apply elastic deformation to a JAX image using random displacement fields smoothed by a Gaussian kernel
affine_transform_image: apply an affine transformation matrix to a JAX image with optional offset and interpolation mode
